about: Saturnus does not react to one record. She speaks only when the log holds two records of the same kind, and she cites both. One record gets silence, not praise.

pair: Two records: wave {pn} at {pplace} at {prev}, and wave {n} at {place} at {time}. A pattern, or a coincidence twice. Filed both, unconcluded.
Shard {pn} at {prev}, shard {n} at {time}. Two entries, same hand. Counted once, counted twice.
Two things looked at, {pplace} at {prev} and {place} at {time}. Two records. That is how a case starts.
Two lamp readings: {pplace} at {prev}, {place} at {time}. Same meter? Write it next to each.
Two saved runs, {prev} and {time}. Good. Now tell me which input you changed, and only that one.
You answered twice, at {prev} and at {time}. The second does not erase the first. Both stay in the ledger.

opener: (adjusts the audit sheet) {act}, {when}. One record. Do you have a second?
